asOfLabel: Tue 22 Sep · first living-facts chassis pack

bullets.text: GAO: in FY2026 Treasury must refinance about $9.7T of maturing securities (order-of-magnitude “~$10T”; mostly bill rollovers, not a long coupon wall).
Debt to the Penny (18 Sep 2026): total public debt outstanding ~$40.10T; debt held by the public ~$32.40T; intragovernmental ~$7.70T. Name which stock when citing ~$40T.
Treasury General Account closing balance 18 Sep 2026: ~$985.9B (Fiscal Data DTS; millions). Near-“$1T” is TGA cash, not a standing $1T buyback program.
Treasury liquidity-support buybacks: long-end nominal ops at least $4B per operation (10y–20y and 20y–30y) from 9 Sep through 4 Nov 2026 (was $2B max). Not a $1T purchase program.
CBO Budget and Economic Outlook 2026–2036: debt held by the public about 101% of GDP in 2026, rising to about 120% by 2036 under current-law baseline.
